Corrects round 2's note, which wrongly said this document makes no claim about Start Task's other-Project answer. It does: startTaskFromWorkItem resolves { task, existing, briefSaved }, and when the open Task is in another Project, task is only { id, projectId } and elsewhere is true. That still matches tasks.ts's existingTaskResult, which now compares Projects as one identity (slug or id). Start Task looks for an open Task in its own Project, or any Project's board-checked Task for the board-checked ref it was given. dismissTaskLearning can now be refused with 409 task_learning_promoted for a claimed version; the SDK's 'dismiss one' line does not claim it always succeeds.
